h1.en: How Much Does an Abortion Cost in North Carolina in 2026?
h1.es: Cuanto Cuesta un Aborto en Carolina del Norte en 2026?

subhero.en: Without insurance, abortion in North Carolina costs $400 to $800 for a medication abortion and $600 to $3,000 for a surgical procedure in 2026, depending on gestational age and facility. North Carolina law (Senate Bill 20, effective July 2023) limits most abortions to 12 weeks, with exceptions through 20 weeks for rape or incest and through 24 weeks for lethal fetal anomalies. NC Medicaid and the ACA marketplace both restrict abortion coverage to Hyde Amendment exceptions only.
subhero.es: Sin seguro, un aborto en Carolina del Norte cuesta entre $400 y $800 para un aborto con medicamentos y entre $600 y $3,000 para un procedimiento quirurgico en 2026, segun la edad gestacional y el centro. La ley de Carolina del Norte (SB 20, vigente desde julio de 2023) limita la mayoria de los abortos a las 12 semanas, con excepciones hasta las 20 semanas por violacion o incesto y hasta las 24 semanas por anomalias fetales letales.

quickAnswer.en: In North Carolina in 2026, a medication abortion (abortion pill) costs $400 to $800 at a clinic, while an in-clinic surgical abortion costs $600 to $1,500 in the first trimester and $1,200 to $3,000 in the second trimester (available under limited exceptions through 20 weeks). Medicare does not cover elective abortion under its National Coverage Determination 140.1. NC Medicaid covers abortion only for life endangerment, rape, or incest. ACA-compliant marketplace plans in North Carolina may not cover elective abortion. Patients who qualify for financial assistance from the Carolina Abortion Fund or the National Abortion Federation can reduce or eliminate out-of-pocket costs. Any patient paying out of pocket has the right to a Good Faith Estimate under the No Surprises Act before the appointment.
quickAnswer.es: En Carolina del Norte en 2026, un aborto con medicamentos (pastilla abortiva) cuesta entre $400 y $800 en una clinica, mientras que un aborto quirurgico en clinica cuesta entre $600 y $1,500 en el primer trimestre y entre $1,200 y $3,000 en el segundo trimestre (disponible bajo excepciones limitadas hasta las 20 semanas). Medicare no cubre el aborto electivo bajo su Determinacion de Cobertura Nacional 140.1. Medicaid de NC cubre el aborto solo en casos de riesgo de vida, violacion o incesto. Los planes del mercado ACA en Carolina del Norte pueden no cubrir el aborto electivo. Los pacientes que califican para asistencia financiera del Carolina Abortion Fund o la Federacion Nacional de Aborto pueden reducir o eliminar los costos de bolsillo.

introParagraphs.en: Abortion in North Carolina became significantly more restricted in July 2023 when Senate Bill 20 took effect, reducing the gestational limit from 20 weeks to 12 weeks for most patients. Exceptions allow abortion through 20 weeks in cases of rape or incest (with documentation) and through 24 weeks for lethal fetal anomalies incompatible with life outside the womb. A life-endangering physical condition permits abortion at any gestational age. Because surrounding states such as South Carolina, Tennessee, and Georgia have near-total bans, North Carolina has become a regional access point, drawing patients from across the Southeast. As of early 2026, NC Health News reports that providers across the state are managing both in-state demand and out-of-state patients under a 12-week framework that requires at minimum two in-person clinic visits.
introParagraphs.es: El aborto en Carolina del Norte se volvio significativamente mas restringido en julio de 2023 cuando entro en vigor el Proyecto de Ley 20 del Senado, reduciendo el limite gestacional de 20 semanas a 12 semanas para la mayoria de los pacientes. Las excepciones permiten el aborto hasta las 20 semanas en casos de violacion o incesto (con documentacion) y hasta las 24 semanas para anomalias fetales letales incompatibles con la vida fuera del utero. Una condicion fisica que pone en peligro la vida permite el aborto a cualquier edad gestacional.

introParagraphs.en: North Carolina requires a 72-hour waiting period between the state-mandated informed consent counseling session and the actual procedure. Under SB 20, medication abortion is restricted to 10 weeks of pregnancy, and patients must attend at least two in-person clinic visits: one for counseling and one for the medication itself. Telehealth abortion pill services that mail medication to patients are not legally permitted in NC under current state law, though shield-law providers based in other states do offer mail-order medication abortion to NC residents at prices of $150 or less. The legal status of those services is unsettled. Patients considering that route should check the current legal landscape through the Reproductive Health Legal Defense Network or similar resources before proceeding.
introParagraphs.es: Carolina del Norte exige un periodo de espera de 72 horas entre la sesion de consentimiento informado mandatada por el estado y el procedimiento real. Bajo SB 20, el aborto con medicamentos esta restringido a las 10 semanas de embarazo, y los pacientes deben asistir a al menos dos visitas presenciales a la clinica. Los servicios de aborto por telemedica que envian medicamentos por correo no estan permitidos legalmente en NC bajo la ley estatal vigente.

introParagraphs.en: This guide covers what abortion costs in North Carolina in 2026, the pricing differences between medication and surgical methods, what Medicare and Medicaid cover, NC insurance restrictions under SB 20, financial assistance programs, and how to use a Good Faith Estimate under the No Surprises Act. For help understanding whether you qualify for Medicaid coverage of related pregnancy services, see the CoveredUSA Medicaid income limits page.
introParagraphs.es: Esta guia cubre el costo del aborto en Carolina del Norte en 2026, las diferencias de precio entre metodos de medicamentos y quirurgicos, lo que cubren Medicare y Medicaid, las restricciones de seguro en NC bajo SB 20, los programas de asistencia financiera y como usar una Estimacion de Buena Fe bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas.

explanationParagraphs.en: The 2026 abortion cost chart in North Carolina reflects the fact that independent clinics, including Planned Parenthood health centers and A Woman's Choice locations in Charlotte and Raleigh, typically charge the lowest cash prices because they specialize in this care and operate with lower overhead than hospital outpatient departments. Independent clinics in NC generally charge $600 to $1,500 for a first-trimester surgical abortion. Hospital outpatient departments and academic medical centers (such as UNC Women's Options Center in Chapel Hill or Duke University Family Planning in Durham) may charge $1,200 to $3,000 or more for first- or second-trimester procedures, partly because of the hospital facility fee that is added to the physician fee.
explanationParagraphs.es: El cuadro de costos de aborto en Carolina del Norte en 2026 refleja que las clinicas independientes, incluyendo los centros de salud de Planned Parenthood y las clinicas A Woman's Choice en Charlotte y Raleigh, generalmente cobran los precios mas bajos en efectivo porque se especializan en esta atencion y operan con menos gastos generales que los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales.

explanationParagraphs.en: Hospital outpatient abortion costs reflect the chargemaster-based facility billing model: patients are charged both a facility fee and a physician fee billed separately. At an independent abortion clinic, fees are typically bundled into one total price that includes the consultation, ultrasound confirmation, the medication or procedure, and a post-care follow-up. Always ask the clinic whether the quoted price is a bundled all-in price or whether ultrasound, anesthesia (local vs. moderate sedation), laboratory work, and the follow-up visit are billed separately. A Good Faith Estimate will itemize each of those components before you schedule.
explanationParagraphs.es: Los costos de aborto en hospitales ambulatorios reflejan el modelo de facturacion basado en la lista de precios del hospital: los pacientes pagan tanto una tarifa de instalacion como una tarifa medica facturada por separado. En una clinica de aborto independiente, los honorarios generalmente se incluyen en un precio total que incluye la consulta, la confirmacion por ultrasonido, el medicamento o procedimiento y el seguimiento posterior.

explanationParagraphs.en: The 72-hour waiting period required by North Carolina law adds a practical cost layer: patients who travel from outside the Triangle or Charlotte area may need to pay for lodging and transportation for two separate trips. Organizations such as the Carolina Abortion Fund and the Brigid Alliance can provide logistical assistance grants in addition to procedure-cost grants for patients who need help covering travel and overnight stays.
explanationParagraphs.es: El periodo de espera de 72 horas requerido por la ley de Carolina del Norte agrega una capa de costos practicos: los pacientes que viajan desde fuera del area de Triangle o Charlotte pueden necesitar pagar alojamiento y transporte para dos viajes separados. Organizaciones como el Carolina Abortion Fund pueden proporcionar subvenciones de asistencia logistica ademas de subvenciones para el costo del procedimiento.

tableFootnote.en: 2026 price ranges reflect FAIR Health Consumer data, Planned Parenthood published self-pay pricing, KFF national abortion cost data (2023 medians, inflation-adjusted to 2026), and NC clinic self-pay schedules. Prices do not include sedation upgrades, Rh-negative blood testing ($50 to $100), or travel costs. Medicare rates reflect CMS National Coverage Determination 140.1 (abortion not covered except for life endangerment, rape, or incest).

Los precios no incluyen mejoras de sedacion, prueba de sangre Rh-negativo ($50 a $100) ni costos de viaje.

intro.en: North Carolina's SB 20 framework divides abortion access into distinct windows by gestational age, each with different provider types, methods, and costs. Medication abortion is available up to 10 weeks; surgical first-trimester abortion up to 12 weeks; second-trimester abortion through 20 weeks only under the rape/incest exception, and through 24 weeks only for lethal fetal anomalies. The cost increases substantially with gestational age.
intro.es: El marco SB 20 de Carolina del Norte divide el acceso al aborto en ventanas distintas por edad gestacional, cada una con diferentes tipos de proveedores, metodos y costos. El aborto con medicamentos esta disponible hasta las 10 semanas; el aborto quirurgico de primer trimestre hasta las 12 semanas; el aborto de segundo trimestre hasta las 20 semanas solo bajo la excepcion de violacion/incesto, y hasta las 24 semanas solo para anomalias fetales letales.

paragraphs.en: Medicare does not cover elective abortion. CMS National Coverage Determination 140.1 limits Medicare Part B coverage of abortion to cases where the pregnancy would place the patient in danger of death due to a physical disorder, injury, or illness, or when the pregnancy resulted from rape or incest. Because elective abortion is excluded from Original Medicare coverage, the 2026 Medicare Part B deductible of $283 and the standard 20% coinsurance do not apply; the full cost falls on the patient for any elective abortion. Medicare Advantage plans follow the same federal coverage restriction and may not offer elective abortion as a supplemental benefit. Medigap supplements do not provide elective abortion coverage either, since there is no underlying Medicare benefit to supplement.
paragraphs.es: Medicare no cubre el aborto electivo. La Determinacion de Cobertura Nacional 140.1 de CMS limita la cobertura de Medicare Parte B del aborto a casos en que el embarazo pondria a la paciente en peligro de muerte debido a un trastorno fisico, lesion o enfermedad, o cuando el embarazo resulto de violacion o incesto. Debido a que el aborto electivo esta excluido de la cobertura de Medicare Original, el deducible de la Parte B de Medicare 2026 de $283 y el coseguro estandar del 20% no aplican; el costo total recae en el paciente.

paragraphs.en: North Carolina Medicaid follows the federal Hyde Amendment, which since 1977 has prohibited use of federal Medicaid funds for abortion except for life endangerment, rape, or incest. North Carolina does not extend state funds to cover elective abortion beyond the Hyde exceptions. Patients who qualify for one of the three Hyde exceptions and are enrolled in NC Medicaid should inform the clinic and ask whether the clinic accepts Medicaid. ACA-compliant marketplace plans sold on the North Carolina health insurance exchange may not include elective abortion coverage under SB 20's insurance restrictions. NC state employees and public school educators lost elective abortion coverage from the state employee health plan under a separate legislative action. As a result, most North Carolina patients seeking abortion pay the full cash price out of pocket.
paragraphs.es: Medicaid de Carolina del Norte sigue la Enmienda Hyde federal, que desde 1977 ha prohibido el uso de fondos federales de Medicaid para aborto, excepto en casos de riesgo de vida, violacion o incesto. Carolina del Norte no extiende fondos estatales para cubrir el aborto electivo mas alla de las excepciones Hyde. Los planes del mercado ACA que cumplen con la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible vendidos en el mercado de seguros de salud de Carolina del Norte pueden no incluir cobertura de aborto electivo bajo las restricciones de seguros de SB 20.

paragraphs.en: Under the No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, any patient paying cash or who is uninsured has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate from the provider before the abortion procedure is scheduled. For a procedure scheduled at least 10 business days out, the provider must furnish the written Good Faith Estimate at least 3 business days before service. For an appointment scheduled 3 to 9 business days out, the Good Faith Estimate arrives at least 1 business day before service. North Carolina abortion clinics are covered by the No Surprises Act GFE requirement, including Planned Parenthood health centers, independent reproductive health clinics, and hospital outpatient abortion services. The federal patient portal is at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, cualquier paciente que paga en efectivo o que no tiene seguro tiene derecho a una Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita del proveedor antes de que se programe el procedimiento de aborto. Para un procedimiento programado con al menos 10 dias habiles de anticipacion, el proveedor debe proporcionar la Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita al menos 3 dias habiles antes del servicio.

paragraphs.en: To request a Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in North Carolina in 2026, follow these steps: (1) Call or contact the clinic and identify yourself as a self-pay patient or uninsured patient. (2) Ask for a written Good Faith Estimate that itemizes the consultation fee, ultrasound, the procedure or medication cost, anesthesia or sedation fee, any laboratory fees, and the follow-up visit. (3) Provide your ZIP code and gestational age so the clinic can provide accurate estimates. (4) Confirm the timing rule: you should receive the GFE at least 3 business days before your appointment if it is scheduled 10 or more business days out, or at least 1 business day before service if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out. (5) Keep the written Good Faith Estimate after you receive it. If your final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, you have 120 days from the date of the bill to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact.
paragraphs.es: Para solicitar una Estimacion de Buena Fe para un aborto en Carolina del Norte en 2026, siga estos pasos: (1) Llame o contacte la clinica e identifiquese como paciente de autopago o sin seguro. (2) Pida una Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita que detalle la tarifa de consulta, el ultrasonido, el costo del procedimiento o medicamento, la tarifa de anestesia o sedacion, cualquier tarifa de laboratorio y la visita de seguimiento. (3) Proporcione su codigo postal y la edad gestacional para que la clinica pueda dar estimaciones precisas. (4) Confirme la regla de tiempo: debe recibir la estimacion al menos 3 dias habiles antes de su cita si esta programada con 10 o mas dias habiles de anticipacion. (5) Conserve la Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita despues de recibirla.

paragraphs.en: A Good Faith Estimate for an abortion procedure is not a guaranteed final bill. Common reasons the actual charges may exceed the estimate include: sedation upgraded from local to IV moderate during the procedure, additional ultrasound imaging needed to confirm gestational age or fetal position, pathology fee if tissue is sent for specimen analysis, additional medication for incomplete evacuation, and extended recovery-room time. If the final bill exceeds the Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, the patient has 120 days from the bill date to file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. Financial assistance organizations such as the Carolina Abortion Fund may also be able to help with unexpectedly high bills after the fact.
paragraphs.es: Una Estimacion de Buena Fe para un procedimiento de aborto no es una factura final garantizada. Las razones comunes por las que los cargos reales pueden exceder la estimacion incluyen: sedacion mejorada de local a IV moderada durante el procedimiento, imagenologia de ultrasonido adicional necesaria para confirmar la edad gestacional o la posicion fetal, honorarios de patologia si se envia tejido para analisis de muestra, medicacion adicional por evacuacion incompleta y tiempo de recuperacion extendido.

items.en: Gestational age at the time of the abortion: the single largest cost driver. A medication abortion at 6 weeks costs $400 to $800; a D&E at 16 weeks can cost $2,000 to $3,500 in North Carolina.
items.es: La edad gestacional en el momento del aborto: el mayor factor de costo. Un aborto con medicamentos a las 6 semanas cuesta $400 a $800; un D&E a las 16 semanas puede costar $2,000 a $3,500 en Carolina del Norte.

items.en: Site of service: independent reproductive health clinics charge $600 to $1,500 for first-trimester surgical procedures, while hospital outpatient departments bill at chargemaster rates that can reach $2,500 to $4,500 for the same gestational age. Always call an independent clinic first for a self-pay cash quote.
items.es: Sitio de servicio: las clinicas de salud reproductiva independientes cobran $600 a $1,500 por procedimientos quirurgicos del primer trimestre, mientras que los departamentos ambulatorios de hospitales facturan a tarifas de lista que pueden alcanzar $2,500 a $4,500. Siempre llame primero a una clinica independiente para obtener una cotizacion de autopago en efectivo.

items.en: Anesthesia or sedation type: local anesthesia (often included in the base price) costs nothing extra. Moderate IV sedation administered by a nurse or anesthesiologist typically adds $150 to $400. Ask whether sedation is included in the bundled price or billed separately.
items.es: Tipo de anestesia o sedacion: la anestesia local (a menudo incluida en el precio base) no tiene costo adicional. La sedacion IV moderada administrada por una enfermera o anestesiologo generalmente agrega $150 a $400. Pregunte si la sedacion esta incluida en el precio empaquetado o se factura por separado.

items.en: Independent clinic self-pay cash bundles: many NC abortion clinics offer all-in bundled cash prices that include the consultation, mandatory NC state counseling, ultrasound, the procedure or medication, and the 72-hour follow-up visit. These bundled prices are 30 to 50 percent below typical hospital outpatient cash rates. Planned Parenthood Chapel Hill and A Woman's Choice Raleigh both publish self-pay schedules online.
items.es: Paquetes de efectivo para autopago en clinicas independientes: muchas clinicas de aborto en NC ofrecen precios en efectivo todo incluido que incluyen la consulta, la orientacion estatal mandatada por NC, el ultrasonido, el procedimiento o medicamento y la visita de seguimiento a las 72 horas. Estos precios empaquetados son entre un 30 y un 50 por ciento por debajo de las tarifas tipicas de efectivo en hospitales ambulatorios.

items.en: Hospital chargemaster discount ask: if you must use a hospital outpatient department, ask the financial counselor for the self-pay or uninsured discount rate before service. Most hospital systems in North Carolina publish a self-pay discount policy that reduces the chargemaster rate by 20 to 60 percent. Some hospitals (such as UNC Health facilities) apply the discount automatically when you identify as self-pay; others require a written request.
items.es: Solicitud de descuento en la lista de precios del hospital: si debe usar un departamento ambulatorio del hospital, pida al asesor financiero la tarifa de descuento para autopago o no asegurado antes del servicio. La mayoria de los sistemas hospitalarios en Carolina del Norte publican una politica de descuento para autopago que reduce la tarifa de la lista del hospital entre un 20 y un 60 por ciento.

items.en: Sliding-scale fees at Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs): a small number of FQHCs in North Carolina provide reproductive health services on a sliding-scale fee schedule tied to household size and income. For patients below 100 percent of the federal poverty level, fees for eligible services can be $0. Not all FQHCs in NC provide abortion services; call ahead to confirm. For income thresholds, see the CoveredUSA federal poverty level page.
items.es: Tarifas en escala movil en Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente (FQHC): un pequeno numero de FQHC en Carolina del Norte proporcionan servicios de salud reproductiva en una escala de tarifas deslizante vinculada al tamano del hogar y los ingresos. Para pacientes por debajo del 100 por ciento del nivel de pobreza federal, las tarifas para servicios elegibles pueden ser $0.

items.en: Financial assistance funds: the Carolina Abortion Fund (carolinaabortionfund.org) provides grants to NC and SC residents with no income requirements. The National Abortion Federation (1-800-772-9100) provides assistance for patients at NAF-member clinics. The Appalachian Abortion Support Collective covers patients in western NC. Funding is limited and based on availability; apply as early as possible once you confirm gestational age.
items.es: Fondos de asistencia financiera: el Carolina Abortion Fund proporciona subvenciones a residentes de NC y SC sin requisitos de ingresos. La Federacion Nacional de Aborto (1-800-772-9100) proporciona asistencia para pacientes en clinicas miembro. El financiamiento es limitado; solicite lo antes posible una vez que confirme la edad gestacional.

items.en: Travel and lodging costs due to NC's 72-hour waiting period: patients traveling more than an hour from the nearest clinic face transportation and possibly overnight lodging costs between the counseling visit and the procedure. These practical costs are real and should be included in the total cost estimate requested in your Good Faith Estimate.
items.es: Costos de viaje y alojamiento debido al periodo de espera de 72 horas de NC: los pacientes que viajan mas de una hora desde la clinica mas cercana enfrentan costos de transporte y posiblemente alojamiento entre la visita de orientacion y el procedimiento.

intro.en: Abortion billing errors most often result from unexpected itemized charges that were not disclosed in a verbal quote. Request a written Good Faith Estimate before your first visit and compare each line item to your final bill. Common billing errors to watch for in North Carolina include:
intro.es: Los errores de facturacion en abortos resultan con mayor frecuencia de cargos detallados inesperados que no se divulgaron en una cotizacion verbal. Solicite una Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita antes de su primera visita y compare cada elemento con su factura final. Los errores comunes de facturacion a vigilar en Carolina del Norte incluyen:

items.en: Ultrasound billed separately when the clinic quoted a bundled price that was supposed to include ultrasound. Ask explicitly: is the ultrasound included in the quoted price?
items.es: Ultrasonido facturado por separado cuando la clinica cotizo un precio empaquetado que se suponia incluia el ultrasonido. Pregunte explicitamente: el ultrasonido esta incluido en el precio cotizado?

items.en: Sedation billed as a separate line item at a higher rate than local anesthesia. If you choose or are offered moderate IV sedation, confirm the additional cost before the procedure and check that it matches the Good Faith Estimate.
items.es: Sedacion facturada como linea separada a una tarifa mas alta que la anestesia local. Si elige o se le ofrece sedacion IV moderada, confirme el costo adicional antes del procedimiento y verifique que coincida con la Estimacion de Buena Fe.

items.en: Pathology fee added for tissue specimen analysis without prior disclosure. Ask the clinic whether any tissue will be sent for pathology and if so, what the fee is, before the procedure.
items.es: Honorario de patologia agregado por analisis de muestra de tejido sin divulgacion previa. Pregunte a la clinica si algun tejido se enviara para patologia y, de ser asi, cual es el honorario, antes del procedimiento.

items.en: Rh-negative blood type test billed without prior consent. This test is medically appropriate for Rh-negative patients but should be disclosed and priced in the Good Faith Estimate.
items.es: Prueba de tipo de sangre Rh negativo facturada sin consentimiento previo. Esta prueba es medicamente apropiada para pacientes Rh negativo pero debe divulgarse y valorarse en la Estimacion de Buena Fe.

items.en: Counseling visit billed as a separate office visit charge on top of the quoted procedure price, even when the state-mandated counseling was supposed to be bundled.
items.es: Visita de orientacion facturada como cargo separado de visita medica ademas del precio del procedimiento cotizado, incluso cuando la orientacion mandatada por el estado se suponia que estaba incluida.

en.question: How much does an abortion cost without insurance in North Carolina in 2026?
en.answer: Without insurance in North Carolina in 2026, a medication abortion (abortion pill) costs $400 to $800 at a clinic. A first-trimester surgical abortion costs $600 to $1,500 at an independent clinic. Second-trimester procedures available under NC's rape/incest exception cost $1,200 to $3,000. Procedures for lethal fetal anomalies through 24 weeks at academic or hospital centers can cost $2,000 to $4,500. Prices depend on gestational age, facility type, sedation choice, and whether ultrasound and follow-up are bundled. The Carolina Abortion Fund and National Abortion Federation provide grants that can reduce or eliminate these costs for patients who qualify.

en.question: Does Medicare cover abortion in North Carolina?
en.answer: Medicare does not cover elective abortion. Original Medicare Part B covers abortion only when the pregnancy poses a direct threat to the patient's life due to a physical condition, or when the pregnancy resulted from rape or incest, under CMS National Coverage Determination 140.1. For elective procedures, the 2026 Medicare Part B deductible of $283 and 20% coinsurance do not apply because there is no Medicare benefit to trigger them. Medicare Advantage and Medigap plans follow the same federal restriction. Patients who are Medicare-enrolled and seeking an abortion under one of the covered exceptions should contact their provider and Medicare directly to verify coverage before the procedure.

en.question: How do I request a Good Faith Estimate for an abortion in North Carolina?
en.answer: Under the No Surprises Act, any patient paying out of pocket has the right to a written Good Faith Estimate before the procedure. To request one: (1) Call the clinic and identify yourself as self-pay or uninsured. (2) Ask for a written Good Faith Estimate itemizing the consultation, ultrasound, procedure or medication, sedation, laboratory fees, and follow-up visit. (3) Provide your gestational age so pricing is accurate. (4) The clinic must deliver the estimate at least 3 business days before service if the appointment is scheduled 10 or more business days out, or at least 1 business day before if scheduled 3 to 9 business days out. (5) If your final bill exceeds the estimate by $400 or more, you can file a dispute at cms.gov/nosurprisesact within 120 days of the bill date.

en.question: What is the No Surprises Act and does it apply to abortion in North Carolina?
en.answer: The No Surprises Act, effective January 1, 2022, is a federal law that requires all health care providers and facilities, including abortion clinics, to give self-pay and uninsured patients a written Good Faith Estimate of expected charges before a scheduled procedure. The law applies to all providers in North Carolina, including Planned Parenthood health centers, independent reproductive health clinics, and hospital outpatient departments. If your final bill is $400 or more above your Good Faith Estimate, you can submit a patient-provider dispute resolution claim within 120 days at the federal portal at cms.gov/nosurprisesact. The No Surprises Act does not change what is covered by insurance; it only guarantees price transparency and dispute rights for self-pay patients.

en.question: How do I get a written cash-pay quote for an abortion in North Carolina?
en.answer: Call the clinic directly and ask: 'What is your self-pay cash price for a medication abortion at X weeks?' or 'What is the bundled cash price for a surgical abortion at X weeks?' Ask whether the quoted price includes the ultrasound confirmation, state-mandated counseling, the procedure or medication, sedation (local vs. IV moderate), and the follow-up visit, or whether those are billed separately. Ask for the quote in writing as a Good Faith Estimate before you schedule. Independent clinics in Charlotte, Raleigh, Durham, Chapel Hill, and Asheville typically have lower self-pay rates than hospital outpatient departments. Planned Parenthood clinics in NC post general price ranges on their websites.

en.question: Can I negotiate an abortion bill after the fact in North Carolina?
en.answer: Yes. If you received services at a hospital outpatient department and the chargemaster bill is higher than expected, you can request the hospital's self-pay or financial hardship discount retroactively. Most North Carolina hospitals reduce bills by 20 to 60 percent for self-pay patients who ask. If the bill exceeds your Good Faith Estimate by $400 or more, file a patient-provider dispute resolution claim at cms.gov/nosurprisesact within 120 days of the bill date. The Carolina Abortion Fund may also be able to help with unexpectedly high bills after the procedure. Always request an itemized bill line by line and check it against your Good Faith Estimate before paying anything.

en.question: What is the difference between a medication abortion and a surgical abortion in North Carolina?
en.answer: A medication abortion (abortion pill) uses two drugs, mifepristone and misoprostol, to end a pregnancy. In North Carolina under SB 20, medication abortion is limited to 10 weeks of pregnancy and requires at least two in-person clinic visits (the state-mandated counseling visit plus the medication visit 72 hours later). A surgical abortion uses aspiration or dilation and evacuation (D&E) and is available up to 12 weeks in NC, and through 20 weeks in rape/incest exception cases. Surgical procedures require fewer medication doses but involve an in-clinic procedure with local anesthesia or sedation. Costs are similar in the first trimester ($400 to $1,500) but diverge sharply in the second trimester, where surgical D&E costs $1,200 to $3,000 or more.

en.question: Does insurance cover abortion in North Carolina?
en.answer: Most health insurance in North Carolina does not cover elective abortion. NC Medicaid follows the federal Hyde Amendment and covers abortion only for life endangerment, rape, or incest with documentation. ACA-compliant marketplace plans sold in North Carolina may not include elective abortion coverage under the state's insurance coverage restrictions. The North Carolina state employee health plan was amended to exclude elective abortion coverage except in limited cases. Employer-sponsored plans vary by employer and plan design; check your plan's Summary of Benefits and Coverage or call the member services line to ask directly. If your plan does cover abortion care and you use an in-network provider, standard deductibles and coinsurance apply.

en.question: What financial assistance is available for abortion in North Carolina?
en.answer: Several organizations provide financial assistance to NC patients: The Carolina Abortion Fund (855-518-4603, carolinaabortionfund.org) has no income requirements and funds both NC residents and out-of-state patients traveling to NC. The National Abortion Federation (1-800-772-9100) assists patients at NAF-member clinics. The Appalachian Abortion Support Collective helps patients in western NC with both procedure costs and practical support such as travel and lodging. Planned Parenthood health centers in NC offer income-based sliding-scale fees. To apply for a grant, contact the fund as soon as possible once you confirm gestational age, since funds are limited and disbursed on a first-come, first-served basis.

en.question: How does North Carolina's abortion law compare to surrounding states in 2026?
en.answer: North Carolina's 12-week gestational limit under SB 20 (with exceptions through 20 or 24 weeks) makes it more permissive than neighboring states with near-total or six-week bans: South Carolina bans abortion after approximately six weeks; Tennessee has a near-total ban; Georgia bans abortion after approximately six weeks of cardiac activity. Virginia allows abortion through the second trimester. This makes North Carolina a regional access hub: patients from SC, TN, and GA travel to NC for care that is unavailable closer to home. The influx of out-of-state patients creates wait times that can push appointments to the edge of the 12-week window, so scheduling quickly after a positive pregnancy test is advisable.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta un aborto sin seguro en Carolina del Norte en 2026?
es.answer: Sin seguro en Carolina del Norte en 2026, un aborto con medicamentos (pastilla abortiva) cuesta de $400 a $800 en una clinica. Un aborto quirurgico en el primer trimestre cuesta de $600 a $1,500 en una clinica independiente. Los procedimientos del segundo trimestre disponibles bajo la excepcion de violacion/incesto de NC cuestan $1,200 a $3,000. Los procedimientos por anomalias fetales letales hasta las 24 semanas en centros academicos u hospitales pueden costar $2,000 a $4,500. Los precios dependen de la edad gestacional, el tipo de instalacion, la eleccion de sedacion y si el ultrasonido y el seguimiento estan incluidos. El Carolina Abortion Fund y la Federacion Nacional de Aborto proporcionan subvenciones que pueden reducir o eliminar estos costos.

es.question: Medicare cubre el aborto en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Medicare no cubre el aborto electivo. Medicare Original Parte B cubre el aborto solo cuando el embarazo representa una amenaza directa para la vida de la paciente debido a una condicion fisica, o cuando el embarazo resulto de violacion o incesto, bajo la Determinacion de Cobertura Nacional 140.1 de CMS. Para procedimientos electivos, el deducible de la Parte B de Medicare 2026 de $283 y el coseguro del 20% no aplican porque no hay un beneficio de Medicare para activarlos. Los planes de Medicare Advantage y Medigap siguen la misma restriccion federal.

es.question: Como solicito una Estimacion de Buena Fe para un aborto en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Bajo la Ley de No Sorpresas, cualquier paciente que paga de su bolsillo tiene derecho a una Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita antes del procedimiento. Para solicitarla: (1) Llame a la clinica e identifiquese como paciente de autopago o sin seguro. (2) Pida una Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita que detalle la consulta, el ultrasonido, el procedimiento o medicamento, la sedacion, los honorarios de laboratorio y la visita de seguimiento. (3) Proporcione su edad gestacional para que los precios sean precisos. (4) La clinica debe entregar la estimacion al menos 3 dias habiles antes del servicio si la cita se programa con 10 o mas dias habiles de anticipacion. (5) Si su factura final excede la estimacion en $400 o mas, puede presentar una disputa en cms.gov/nosurprisesact dentro de los 120 dias posteriores a la fecha de la factura.

es.question: Que es la Ley de No Sorpresas y aplica al aborto en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: La Ley de No Sorpresas, vigente desde el 1 de enero de 2022, es una ley federal que exige a todos los proveedores y establecimientos de atencion medica, incluidas las clinicas de aborto, dar a los pacientes de autopago y sin seguro una Estimacion de Buena Fe escrita de los cargos esperados antes de un procedimiento programado. La ley aplica a todos los proveedores en Carolina del Norte. Si su factura final es $400 o mas por encima de su Estimacion de Buena Fe, puede presentar un reclamo de resolucion de disputas paciente-proveedor dentro de los 120 dias en el portal federal en cms.gov/nosurprisesact.

es.question: Como obtengo una cotizacion por escrito de pago en efectivo para un aborto en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Llame directamente a la clinica y pregunte: 'Cual es su precio en efectivo para autopago para un aborto con medicamentos a X semanas?' o 'Cual es el precio en efectivo todo incluido para un aborto quirurgico a X semanas?' Pregunte si el precio cotizado incluye la confirmacion por ultrasonido, la orientacion mandatada por el estado, el procedimiento o medicamento, la sedacion y la visita de seguimiento, o si se facturan por separado. Pida la cotizacion por escrito como Estimacion de Buena Fe antes de programar.

es.question: Puedo negociar una factura de aborto despues del procedimiento en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Si. Si recibio servicios en un departamento ambulatorio de hospital y la factura de la lista de precios es mas alta de lo esperado, puede solicitar el descuento para autopago o dificultades financieras del hospital de forma retroactiva. La mayoria de los hospitales de Carolina del Norte reducen las facturas entre un 20 y un 60 por ciento para pacientes de autopago que lo solicitan. Si la factura supera su Estimacion de Buena Fe en $400 o mas, presente un reclamo de resolucion de disputas paciente-proveedor en cms.gov/nosurprisesact dentro de los 120 dias posteriores a la fecha de la factura.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre un aborto con medicamentos y un aborto quirurgico en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Un aborto con medicamentos (pastilla abortiva) utiliza dos farmacos, mifepristona y misoprostol, para terminar un embarazo. En Carolina del Norte bajo SB 20, el aborto con medicamentos esta limitado a las 10 semanas de embarazo y requiere al menos dos visitas presenciales a la clinica. Un aborto quirurgico usa aspiracion o dilatacion y evacuacion (D&E) y esta disponible hasta las 12 semanas en NC. Los costos son similares en el primer trimestre ($400 a $1,500) pero divergen notablemente en el segundo trimestre, donde la D&E quirurgica cuesta $1,200 a $3,000 o mas.

es.question: El seguro cubre el aborto en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: La mayoria de los seguros de salud en Carolina del Norte no cubren el aborto electivo. Medicaid de NC sigue la Enmienda Hyde federal y cubre el aborto solo por riesgo de vida, violacion o incesto con documentacion. Los planes del mercado ACA vendidos en Carolina del Norte pueden no incluir cobertura de aborto electivo. Los planes patrocinados por el empleador varian; consulte el Resumen de Beneficios y Cobertura de su plan o llame a servicios al miembro para preguntar directamente.

es.question: Que asistencia financiera esta disponible para el aborto en Carolina del Norte?
es.answer: Varias organizaciones proporcionan asistencia financiera a pacientes de NC: El Carolina Abortion Fund (855-518-4603) no tiene requisitos de ingresos y financia tanto a residentes de NC como a pacientes de otros estados que viajan a NC. La Federacion Nacional de Aborto (1-800-772-9100) ayuda a pacientes en clinicas miembro. El Appalachian Abortion Support Collective ayuda a pacientes en el oeste de NC. Las clinicas de Planned Parenthood en NC ofrecen tarifas en escala movil basadas en ingresos. Solicite una subvencion lo antes posible una vez que confirme la edad gestacional.

es.question: Como se compara la ley de aborto de Carolina del Norte con los estados vecinos en 2026?
es.answer: El limite gestacional de 12 semanas de Carolina del Norte bajo SB 20 (con excepciones hasta 20 o 24 semanas) la hace mas permisiva que los estados vecinos con prohibiciones casi totales o de seis semanas: Carolina del Sur prohibe el aborto despues de aproximadamente seis semanas; Tennessee tiene una prohibicion casi total; Georgia prohibe el aborto despues de aproximadamente seis semanas de actividad cardiaca. Esto hace que Carolina del Norte sea un centro de acceso regional, con pacientes de SC, TN y GA que viajan a NC para atenci6n no disponible mas cerca de casa.
